title: Underwater Ocean Adventure
text: A young diver with scuba gear swims through a vibrant coral reef with tropical fish. She discovers a sunken pirate ship covered in seaweed and treasure chests. A wise old sea turtle guides her back to the surface through rays of sunlight.
